text:
emily: quick sync 3 kepler labs pinged about an independent perf/W sweep for our 20B/40B delta on their new 'Spark' mezzanine cards. they want a reproducible artifact for marketplace qualification and a short co-announce if results are stable.
thomas: good. what exact metrics are they asking for?
emily: steady-state perf/W (1h trimmed mean), tokens/sec, latency p50/p95, thermal headroom (max die temp), and kernel stability count (panics/crashes). also raw power series for audit.
kepler_eng: kepler can provide on-board powermeter telemetry + IPMI for redundancy. firmware: spark-1.2.4. kernel-tune: spark-opt-v1. note: our tune flips sm_prefetch and l1_split. we'll publish a small flash-and-revert script.
maya: infra ask: we should run both models (redwood-20b and redwood-40b) and two kernel configs (redwood-default, spark-opt-v1). propose 2 runs each config, 70m steady after a 10m warmup. sample power @1s, thermals @5s.
thomas: agree. add a calibration step: fixed synthetic load for 5m to steady power baseline. skip first 10m for measurements.
emily: run id pattern:
RUN_ID="kepler-spark-2026-07-21-01"
TAGS=("kepler" "spark" "perfW" "20B" "40B")
thomas: sample run command:
```
RUN_ID="$RUN_ID" ./bench_run \
  --model redwood-20b --seq 6144 --batch 2 --streaming \
  --duration 4800 --warmup 600 \
  --collector http://metrics-collector.internal:8200/post \
  --tag "$RUN_ID"
```
kepler_eng: we'll provide a manifest with powermeter CSV endpoint and IPMI dump, plus a kernel toggle script: flip_spark_tune.sh. we'll also mirror our stress-test harness.
ops-bot: Lab availability: 2026-07-21 19:00 PT or 2026-07-22 02:00 PT. Please confirm preferred slot.
emily: prefer evening slot 2026-07-21 19:00 PT to avoid daytime QA. ops-bot: booking confirmed: kepler-bay-1 2026-07-21T19:00:00-07:00 booking_id=KB-99011
maya: collector payload schema (required fields): run_id, partner, model, kernel_label, firmware_id, batch_size, seq_len, tokens_per_sec, power_mean_w, power_p95_w, thermal_max_c, latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms, panic_count, raw_power_series_url, artifact_url. please include bench_git_sha.
thomas: add note: include kv_cache_warmup=true/false and provide explicit warmup duration in metadata. i'll ensure bench script tags warmup window and measured window.
kepler_eng: powermeter sampling aligned to bench wallclock, we'll include timestamps in UTC iso8601. we recommend 1s granularity for power.
legal-bot: Reminder: co-announce requires signed NDA/Joint PR MOU. legal review turnaround target is 72 hours. confirm you want an embargo window?
emily: yes, request 3 business days embargo after we deliver validated numbers to Kepler. legal-bot: noted.
maya: risks: thermal throttling after ~50m on early silicon, IPMI probe missed samples, network egress jitter. mitigations: preflight thermal stress test, redundant powermeter, isolated perf VLAN and local collector, good NTP config.
thomas: i'll add a watchdog that restarts bench on hang and records reboot events to artifact.zip. also include a calibration subcommand: --calibrate-load --duration 300 that emits steady_power_w.
kepler_eng: one gotcha: our spark-opt-v1 toggles L1 split which can change throughput distribution; we'll include a small perf test that validates model logits match within epsilon of redwood-default to ensure no correctness regressions.
emily: marketing/pm note: if numbers look favorable we'll want: 1) short marketplace blurb, 2) co-blog draft, 3) shared benchmark tile. maya, can you own the reproducibility bundle and place it under experiments/kepler/spark-bench/ ?
maya: yes. bundle will include docker tag redwood/bench:2026-07-21, env.sample, run.sh, metrics-mapping.json, and a README with run steps. i'll also add an upload hook to push artifacts to our collector with tags: kepler,spark,perfW.
ops-bot: Preflight reminder created: 2026-07-19T09:00:00-07:00. reminder_id=PRF-55823
emily: action items recap: thomas -> bench script + calibration + baseline hosted runs; kepler_eng -> powermeter + kernel toggle scripts + stress harness; maya -> reproducibility bundle + collector mapping; ops-bot -> lab booking + VLAN; legal-bot -> MOU template and embargo gating. target dry-run 2026-07-19 09:00 PT; official run 2026-07-21 19:00 PT.
thomas: i'll push experiment under experiments/kepler/spark-bench/ with README and a small perf runner by EOD. tagging this thread for visibility.
emily: thanks team. post run artifacts here and ping for the preflight checklist. :rocket:
